confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by season, booking lead time, and property. Las Palmas is a mid-sized port and tourist city; the Canary Islands use the lower IGIC tax rate rather than mainland IVA, which slightly lowers prices. Cocktail and wine anchors are based on their usual relationship to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of local prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Spanish port and tourist cities with similar pricing, such as Málaga and Alicante, adjusted for Canary Islands tax and the Las Canteras beach-area tourist market. No single comparable city was used.
